description: RestageIFC: A Complete IFC Dataset of the Restage Demonstrator from the Reference Construction Site Aachen is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chu Han Wu, Görkem Can Ertemli (RWTH Aachen University). This dataset contains an IFC model of the Restage demonstrator on the Reference Construction Site at RWTH Aachen Campus Melaten. The site is located at Maria-Lipp-Strasse, 52074 Aachen. The model represents the site layout and the detailed IFC structure of the demonstrator. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
